target.basis: Target of the historical Cuttlefish boot (docs/upstream/VALIDATION.md, 2026-10-24, framework 84183aff); that boot is not evidence for any current candidate. device/google/cuttlefish is pinned in os/pinned-manifest.xml (283645aa, android-17.0.0_r1). The emulator reference scripts' sdk_phone64 target, roots and in-place product edits are not used

build.basis: Own OUT_DIR beside the Pixel outDir, under the shared builder lock; nothing is cleaned. droid builds the guest images into PRODUCT_OUT; hosttar is the host package goal (hostPackage). requiredImages is a minimum, not the full launcher input list, which is unverified for this tree. minFreeGiB is a policy margin, not a measured output size

hostPackage.basis: Read from the pinned device/google/cuttlefish 283645aa (no compile): build/cvd-host-package.go registers the Soong cvd_host_package module type, installs <module>.tar.gz into the module's host install directory (HOST_OUT) and declares the hosttar phony only for the vsoc board platforms; build/Android.bp declares cvd_host_package cvd-host_package; vsoc_x86_64_only/BoardConfig.mk sets TARGET_BOARD_PLATFORM vsoc_x86_64. There is no Makefile hosttar. Preflight checks the plugin's sha256 and these declarations in the retained tree, and lunch must resolve this board platform

sourceBinding.basis: The alpha builds the retained tree exactly as the last Pixel integration reconciled it: it never reconciles, adopts, signs apps or edits the tree. Bind it only from the builder's latest host-reconcile receipt (file name and sha256), the candidate SHA and dispatched apps of the run that wrote it; the build refuses any other candidate and any drift from that receipt's entries
sourceBinding.evidence: Lead's read-only host inspection, 2026-10-28 (INFRA-ALPHA-082): reconcile receipt 0004-2026102804.json (written 2026-10-28T09:59:03Z) is the latest and none of its 15 entries has drifted; the immutable 2026102804 stage chain (000-init to 010-completed) names candidate ae9cfd4d; aapt and hashes of the integrated apps match 2804 (Rose Agent 302 01b184b4..., Calculator 4 9f46c1a2..., controller 28 f39936b1...). Rose Agent 303 never reconciled this tree. apps uses the order of the 2804 dispatch (scripts/tests/test_release_candidate_contract.py APPS), so the alpha dispatch passes exactly this list

hostEvidence.basis: Values from a passing emulator-alpha.py probe on the builder under the lock: TARGET_PRODUCT, TARGET_BUILD_VARIANT, TARGET_BOARD_PLATFORM, PRODUCT_DEVICE, PRODUCT_OUT and HOST_OUT from get_build_var, and TARGET_RELEASE as exported by lunch into the shell (get_build_var returns it empty in this tree), with the alpha OUT_DIR. The failed first probe and the 081 diagnosis are not probe receipts. Until recorded, guard and builder fail closed

artifact.name: emulator-alpha-receipt-{run_id}
artifact.basis: Only the nonsecret build receipt and SHA256SUMS; the images stay in the alpha OUT_DIR, hashed in the receipt for the separate guest operation
